## Pull Request Summary

### Description
Provide a concise overview of the change, design context, and technical approach.

### Related Issue
Closes #[issue-number]

### Validation Steps
1.  Did `npm run typecheck` complete with zero errors? [Yes/No]
2.  Did `npm run build` compile the production bundle successfully? [Yes/No]

### Accessibility (WCAG AA) & Performance Impact
*   Does this preserve keyboard navigation and ARIA tags?
*   Has rendering efficiency been optimized to avoid unnecessary re-renders?
